samples.summary: The two other changed `toggleList` exit call sites (text-editor, text-box-editor) have no heading-restore test
samples.evidence: The new suite packages/docs/test/view/list-heading-roundtrip.test.ts only drives `initialize()`'s `toggleList` (editor.ts). `TextEditor.toggleList` (text-editor.ts:2164, reachable only via Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+7/8) and `initializeTextBox`'s `toggleList` (text-box-editor.ts:1122) were changed identically but nothing asserts the heading comes back through them. The only existing text-box test (packages/docs/test/view/text-box-editor.test.ts:327-337) is a smoke test: it asserts `typeof api.toggleList === 'function'` and `not.toThrow()` on a paragraph with no selection — it cannot fail if the exit path regressed. The shared helper `unlistedBlockType` is tested, so the residual risk is only that a call site drifts back to hardcoded 'paragraph'.

samples.summary: Yorkie `splitBlock` no-inline-children branch keeps headingLevel but is untested
samples.evidence: The new frontend test (yorkie-doc-store.test.ts, 'should carry a bulleted heading level onto the split-off list-item') splits a block whose inlines are `[{text:'HelloWorld'}]`, so `hasInlineChildren` is true and execution takes the else branch at yorkie-doc-store.ts:2136-2148. The parallel change at 2051-2056 (the empty/no-inline-children path, which is exactly the empty-bullet Enter case) is never exercised; deleting that hunk would leave both suites green.

samples.summary: The central safety claim — a retained `headingLevel` on a `list-item` is inert for every reader — has no test
samples.evidence: The new `Block.headingLevel` doc comment (types.ts:54-60) and the task doc assert that export (markdown/docx/pdf), `blockStyleId` and toolbar labels all gate on `type === 'heading'`, so a bulleted heading is visually/semantically a plain bullet. No test in the diff renders, serializes or exports a `list-item` carrying `headingLevel: 2`; e.g. pdf-exporter.ts:201 outline, docx-exporter.ts:184, serialize/markdown.ts:104, named-styles.ts:99 blockStyleId, and editor.ts:2793 `getBlockType()` (which returns headingLevel unconditionally to the toolbar) are all untouched by the new suite. A single assertion (e.g. `blockStyleId(bulletedHeading) === 'normal'` and markdown export emits a bullet, not `##`) would pin the invariant the whole design rests on.

samples.summary: toggleList round-trip only covers a collapsed cursor, never a multi-block selection
samples.evidence: All three `toggleList` tests set a collapsed selection on a single block (lines 206-209, 223-226, 239-242). `toggleList` iterates via `forEachBlockInSelection` (editor.ts:2867), so the mixed case — a selection spanning a heading and a paragraph, where each block must exit to a different type — is untested.
